notes: The OG Widget shows its resolution in the footer again, on the right beside the sensor count, in the same physical pixels the size presets are labelled with — so it reads 220x168 rather than the smaller figure a scaled display actually…

The OG Widget is now fixed-width with a height that follows its content, and that is no longer something that can be changed. It is a narrow strip whose job is to list whatever sensors the machine reports; a width the user could drag was…

Its size controls have been removed from Panel Settings to match. Offering a choice the panel then overrules is worse than not offering it. The Displays and Theme sections are unchanged, so it can still be moved to another monitor and…

This is declared by the theme rather than hardcoded for OG, so a future widget-style theme gets the same behaviour by saying so, and the full-stage themes keep their resolution presets exactly as they were.
